{{verse|chapter=6|verse=53}} And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 14, 34.''}}* vvhen they had pa{{ls}}{{ls}}ed ouer, they came into the land of Genezareth, and {{ls}}et to the {{ls}}hore. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=54}} And vvhen they vvere gone out of the boate, incontinent they knevv him: {{verse|chapter=6|verse=55}} and running through that vvhole countrie, they began to carie about in couches tho{{ls}}e that vvere il at ea{{ls}}e, vvhere they heard he vvas. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=56}} And vvhither{{ls}}oeuer he entred into tovvnes or into villages or cities, they laid the {{ls}}icke in the {{ls}}treates, and be{{ls}}ought him that they might touche but the hemme of his garment: and as many as touched him, vvere made vvhole.⊣
